title: projecting dream realities, scorpio iii
content:
this series is created for my collaboration with LJ of Ceremony for their communal writing practice, Atmospheres, based of the 36 decans of the astrological year.

Scorpio III — 12 November – 21 November
Key themes from LJ — phantasmagoria, dreams, fairy tales
Before this: dosing the poison cure, scorpio II

*

I was born under this decan. it is like being born with a kaleidoscopic lens attached to my face — I can look at something and see infinite possibility for what it could become. this goes both ways: I see potential, and I see phantoms.

for this decan, I drew a deep, dreamy watery landscape that feels like home to me. there is a full moon casting light into the waters, a boat on the threshold, fish and jellyfish moving, a mermaid swimming into a portal.

*

in my human design chart, my key sense is that of inner visioning. things occur in my mind, and then they become real. for me, the line between fantasizing, planning, and making something happen — is a very thin veil; a slippery slope. this is why being born in the digital age has been such a gift for me. I’ve created everything in my business and creative world through this alchemizing energy.

if I indulged myself and my imagination, I could easily live inside a film plot, in the land of dreams, fantasies, myths, or fairytales (probably not the kind that ends happily ever after), or in the space of alternate, parallel lives. sometimes the cinema screen of my mind takes me back to moments I’ve lived in this life, or moments that may never happen, and I experience it as tiny, momentary collisions. those projected realities can feel more real than the physical world I’m actually in. fantasy sounds dangerous and bad, but I’m not sure that it actually is. all real things begin as fantasies, and if anything, the imaginary is a portal into very real things.

*

through the atmosphere rituals with LJ, I discovered that making art — especially writing — IS a process that channels this energy. it is about perspective. looking at life through a prism, and seeing where the light lands. I write that down. the deeply specific and personal becomes an offering that I release into the world, and share.

I know that this is a gift I must be very, very careful with — to channel my kaleidoscopic vision as a force for making art, and new possibility in the world — and not as escapism, but as diving deeper into what is here, in this life, for me.
